title: Naturality of the chain restriction between supplied closed-test models
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Use the specified TestModel, sourceModel, targetModel, chainRestriction, modelMap and localizationModel [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-model-diagrams]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $a\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ affine, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $(h:X_Z\to X,f_Z:X_Z\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/a))$ the pullback of $f$ along the closed immersion [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $V$ be an affine pro-etale test over $\operatorname{Spec}(A/a)$ such that both $V$ and its specified closed-site lift are w-contractible [def-exc-closed-site-lift, sk-def-pe-wlocal]. For arbitrary unbounded derived $\Lambda_X$-modules $K,N$, every actual derived arrow $\alpha:K\to N$ and supplied TestModels $M,P$ of $K,N$, The chain restriction square commutes: chainRestriction(M) followed by modelMap on the pullbacks equals modelMap(alpha) followed by chainRestriction(P). This asserts only the chain square, without the source, target or localization comparison squares.

proof.text: Use rightDerivedPullback_app_Q_obj at M.I,M.J,M.j and naturality at M.e.hom. Expand pullRepresentative and cancel M.e.hom followed by M.e.inv. This expresses chainRestriction(M) by the computation units and representatives surrounding derivedSectionArrow(K). Repeat for P.

Expand both modelMap formulas. Computation units on the supplied K-injective complexes are inverses of computation isomorphisms. Cancel adjacent isomorphisms, use functoriality to combine images, then use naturality of derivedSectionArrow at alpha.

lean.statement:
theorem closed_test_chain_model_map_naturality
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (a : Ideal A)
    {X XZ : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (h : XZ ⟶ X) (fZ : XZ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ a)))
    (w : IsPullback h fZ f (closedMap A a))
    (V : (Spec (.of (A ⧸ a))).AffineProEt)
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)]
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ((liftedTest A a V).left, ⊤)]
    {K N : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))}
    (α : K ⟶ N) (M : TestModel Λ h K) (P : TestModel Λ h N) :
    chainRestriction Λ A a w V M.I M.J M.j ≫
        modelMap Λ (testFibre fZ (closedTest A a V)) M.J P.J M.pullIso P.pullIso
          ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ h).mapDerivedCategory.map α) =
      modelMap Λ (testFibre f (liftedTest A a V)) M.I P.I M.e P.e α ≫
        chainRestriction Λ A a w V P.I P.J P.j
